description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.1 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This one fixes the settings screen. On 0.1.0 its row titles were drawn in Facebook's near-black text on the black page, and the Export diagnostic report and Clear diagnostic data rows came up blank.

13 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your own browser, stories and reels can be saved, and there's an AMOLED black theme if you want one.

Validation: 73 runtime tests passed locally. All 73 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 13 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.31.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
